d: Could the US-Iran conflict take an even more dangerous turn? Donald Trump’s latest “hammer” threat has intensified speculation over Washington’s next move, while Gulf nations remain concerned about the possibility of a stronger Iranian retaliation. With regional tensions running high, fears of further military escalation have put the Middle East on edge. Is a nuclear strike on Iran a real possibility, or is the rhetoric part of a broader strategy to pressure Tehran? What could Iran’s response mean for Gulf security and the wider region? Hem Kaur Saroya explains on Vantage tonight.
